KP06-P11-code.name: KP06-P11-code
KP06-P11-code.text:
```python
import numpy as np
t=np.arange(-2,3)
X=np.column_stack((t,t*t))
Xc=X-X.mean(axis=0)
C=Xc.T@Xc/len(t)
theta=np.linspace(0,np.pi,5)
P=np.c_[np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta)]
delta=np.diff(P,axis=0)
segments=np.linalg.norm(delta,axis=1)
length=segments.sum()
```

KP06-P13-title.text: 只改曲率，最大變異方向與碰撞會如何改變？

KP06-P13-context.name: KP06-P13-context
